title: Work on organ transplant institute in Kozhikode to be completed in 30 months, says Satheesan
description: Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan says that ₹271 crore is being set aside for the institute coming up on a 20-acre plot in Chevayur. All services related to organ transplantation will be brought under one roof to reduce the cost of surgery to one-third.
